name: Dogwood Solar
old_description: Dogwood Solar has helped numerous home and business owners in Missouri go solar through the installation of solar panels, battery backup systems and more. Learn more about the solar options right for you.
about:
Dogwood Solar is based in Columbia, Missouri, and has been serving the state since 2010. The company is owned and operated by Dan Shifley, who holds NABCEP certification and a Master Electrician license in Columbia. Shifley founded the business with a mission to promote solar energy alternatives and provide sustainable options to homeowners and business owners.

The firm specializes in the design and installation of solar photovoltaic systems and battery backup storage for residential and commercial properties. Services include site analysis, energy needs assessment, system design, permitting, and installation performed by a licensed electrical team. Dogwood Solar provides a 10-year workmanship warranty in addition to manufacturer warranties on equipment.

Customers range from homeowners in Boone County and surrounding areas to businesses and non-profit organizations across Missouri. The company has completed projects for repeat clients and participates in community events such as the Columbia Earth Day Festival and the Green Expo.

Shifley emphasizes a no-pressure, educational approach, walking clients through options without overselling. The team stresses respect for property, thorough cleanup, and long-term utility savings as core differentiators.
